title: Python ML: Categorical Data
description: Machine learning models require numerical input. When you have categorical data (labels like 'Red', 'Blue', 'Green'), you must convert them into numbers. One-Hot Encoding is a common method where each category becomes a new column with values 0 or 1. 'pandas.get_dummies()' makes this easy.
example:
# One-Hot Encoding with Pandas
import pandas

df = pandas.DataFrame({'Car': ['BMW', 'Volvo', 'Ford']})
dummied = pandas.get_dummies(df['Car'])

print(dummied)
# Output will be columns for BMW, Volvo, Ford with 0s and 1s
